Good afternoon. Thank you for joining us for our Q3 2019 earnings call.
I'm the Chief Executive Officer of COST.
Operating income reached $7.4 billion, demonstrating the operating leverage in our model.
We expect revenues to grow approximately 20% to 22% next quarter, subject to market conditions.
I'll now turn the call over to our CFO for a more detailed financial review.
Thank you. Our Chief Financial Officer will now provide the financial details for Q3 2019.
Customer acquisition exceeded our targets with 144 thousand new accounts added in the quarter.
Our outlook assumes current foreign exchange rates hold; currency fluctuations could materially affect results.
We will now begin the question-and-answer session.
Analyst - First question:
How are you thinking about pricing power versus volume growth in the current environment?
Thank you for the question. We generated $5.3 billion in free cash flow, enabling us to return capital to shareholders.
Second question - Analyst:
How should we think about the cadence of revenue recognition in the second half?
Revenue guidance of $41.2 billion assumes no further deterioration in consumer spending trends.
